description: Hi-net high sensitivity seismograph network (NIED) is a data network run by National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience (NIED), Japan. Hi-net distributes continuous waveform data and earthquake catalogues from a nationwide network of borehole seismographs operated by NIED, for registered researchers. Coverage: Japan (nationwide network, about 800 stations). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as win32, sac; access is free of charge; waveform download needs registered research use. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("NIED Hi-net β Ver. [High Sensitivity Seismograph Network Japan]") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support ground-motion input for seismic hazard and fragility studies of Japanese infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
